services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Imagine hosting your next soccer league, celebrating that long-awaited 25th family reunion, or simply reserving the playground to bring your Boy Scout troop together for a day of fun and connection. At Quillian Center, we provide the space, amenities, and flexibility to make it all possible. Rentals are open to individuals, corporations, and non-profits from 6 PM - 10 PM Monday through Friday. On Saturdays and Sundays, our facilities are available from 9 AM - 8 PM. Our facility features a wide range of rental options, including a full gymnasium, well-maintained athletic fields, a welcoming outdoor pavilion, and a safe, engaging playground.
